lines.en: - You've been quiet all morning, is everything okay?
Um, well, I'm gonna go grab us some breakfast.
- In the future, when a girl asks
for some ill-advised sympathy sex, just do it.
- Wait, wait, you're, uh, you're mad at me?
I-I was just trying to do the right thing.
Well, it seems to me if you had done the right thing,
I would not have woken up today
I would have woken up feeling comforted and satisfied.
What are you, I-I was just being a good guy.
I treated you with-with respect and understanding.
- Hey, I was looking out for you.
I don't need someone telling me what is best for me.
- I gotta say, I've not had sex a lot of times before.
Well, it wasn't very good for me either.
To avoid this little thing in the future,
let's just say you and me, never having sex again.
I am never having sex with you again.
Dr. Green, are you feeling better?
